episodes.title: In Case of Emergency
episodes.summary: Flight attendant Cassie Bowden has an extravagant, romantic, and very drunk night in Bangkok. When she wakes up in a horrific mess, Cassie must keep her wits to make it back to the U.S. - where more trouble is waiting.

episodes.title: Rabbits
episodes.summary: Rattled by her own lies and under pressure from the FBI, Cassie goes against her lawyer friend Annie's advice to lay low and tries to find some answers by digging into Alex's work life - with bizarre and shocking results.

episodes.title: Funeralia
episodes.summary: Returning from Rome to find that someone has broken into her apartment, Cassie doubles down on finding Miranda – even if it means crashing a champagne-soaked memorial service at Alex's family home.

episodes.title: Conspiracy Theories
episodes.summary: Cassie follows a surprising paper trail to a suspiciously empty private jet service. Later, a visit from her brother Davey forces Cassie to confront her memories of her "unconventional" childhood.

episodes.title: Other People's Houses
episodes.summary: With Miranda on her tail and the FBI closing in, Cassie enlists Max in a plan that involves breaking and entering, computer fraud, and too much vodka. Meanwhile, Annie's work life takes an ominous turn.

episodes.title: After Dark
episodes.summary: Reeling from a major fallout with Annie, Cassie spirals into an alcohol-fueled escapade that ends in a meltdown.

episodes.title: Hitchcock Double
episodes.summary: Cassie is forced to work with an unlikely ally. Megan's life threatens to implode when her husband starts asking questions.

episodes.title: Arrivals and Departures
episodes.summary: Cassie comes face to face with Alex's killer. Annie works with the FBI. Megan comes clean.

episodes.title: Seeing Double
episodes.summary: Now almost a year sober, Cassie has started fresh in LA with her supportive new boyfriend, Marco. But her side gig moonlighting as a CIA asset soon finds Cassie entangled in an international murder mystery… again.

episodes.title: Mushrooms, Tasers, and Bears, Oh My!
episodes.summary: After revealing her secret side gig to Annie and Max, Cassie sets out to find the woman who's been impersonating her – and zeros in on enigmatic new flight attendant Grace.

episodes.title: The Reykjavík Ice Sculpture Festival Is Lovely This Time of Year
episodes.summary: A cryptic text leads Cassie to search for Megan in Reykjavík, where Shane grows increasingly suspicious of his friend's erratic travels. Back in LA, Annie and Max face unexpected turbulence.

episodes.title: Blue Sincerely Reunion
episodes.summary: After attempting to get Megan safely out of Reykjavík, Cassie fears she's being framed for murder when two bodies are found in Echo Park.

episodes.title: Drowning Women
episodes.summary: After finding potentially incriminating photos in Benjamin's office, Cassie seeks assurances from Shane – and continues to avoid Marco – while Megan searches for an all-important lockbox.

episodes.title: Brothers & Sisters
episodes.summary: Cassie faces hard truths about her path to sobriety while visiting her mom as Megan attempts to reconnect with her family, who are reluctant to welcome her back.

episodes.title: No Exit
episodes.summary: Cassie, Shane, Annie, and Max attempt to run down clues in the string of murders – which continue to point to Cassie as the main suspect.

episodes.title: Backwards and Forwards
episodes.summary: Cassie manages to connect the dots in a far-reaching conspiracy, while Megan tries to make amends with Shane.
